items.title_en: HiSTEVE 1.0: Harnessing Human-Interface VLA Agents for Open-World Games
items.title_zh: HiSTEVE 1.0：利用人机接口 VLA 智能体玩转开放世界游戏
items.abstract_en: Building virtual embodied agents that operate in open-ended games like human players is a long-standing goal requiring both long-horizon autonomy and reliable native-interface control. As a procedurally generated open world, Minecraft provides a natural testbed for studying the integration of these capabilities. Existing agents typically provide either native visuomotor control without long-horizon autonomy or high-level planning executed through environment APIs or predefined skills. To bridge this gap, we propose HiSTEVE, a hierarchical VLA agent with a capability-aware agent harness. At the orchestration level, we equip the harness with structured memory for tracking progress and a VLM planner for selecting subtasks within the VLA's capabilities. To reliably determine subtask completion, we further introduce a policy-coupled task completion state detector that conditions on VLA policy context to signal candidate completion. At the control level, a single VLA executes all subtasks with vision-only perception and native keyboard-and-mouse actions. To mitigate interference between heterogeneous GUI and non-GUI interactions, we introduce regime-specific RMSNorm branches and separate mouse-movement token embeddings. We also train the VLA through world knowledge injection, imitation learning, and reinforcement learning with environment feedback to improve reliability and recovery. HiSTEVE achieves state-of-the-art atomic-task performance, scoring 85.0% on MineStudio Bench and a 37.4% average success rate on OpenHA, while also completing long-horizon tasks such as crafting an iron pickaxe from scratch like human players.
items.abstract_zh: 构建像人类玩家一样在开放式游戏中行动的虚拟具身智能体，既需要长时程自主性，也需要可靠的原始界面控制。Minecraft 作为程序生成的开放世界，为研究二者结合提供了天然试验场。现有智能体要么具备原生视觉运动控制但缺乏长时程自主性，要么通过环境 API 或预定义技能执行高层规划。为此我们提出 HiSTEVE：一种带能力感知外壳的分层 VLA 智能体。编排层配备用于跟踪进度的结构化记忆，以及只在 VLA 能力范围内选择子任务的 VLM 规划器，并引入策略耦合的任务完成状态检测器判定子任务完成；控制层由单个 VLA 以纯视觉感知和原生键鼠操作执行全部子任务，并通过分模式 RMSNorm 分支与独立鼠标移动 token 嵌入缓解 GUI 与非 GUI 交互的干扰。VLA 经世界知识注入、模仿学习与强化学习训练。HiSTEVE 在 MineStudio Bench 上得分 85.0%，在 OpenHA 上平均成功率 37.4%，并能像玩家一样从零制作铁镐。
items.highlight_zh: 分层 VLA 加能力感知外壳，纯键鼠在 Minecraft 完成长时程任务
items.digest_zh:
1) 研究问题：让 AI 像人一样“玩”Minecraft 这类开放世界游戏，难点有两层：既要长时间自主地推进目标（长时程自主性），又要像人一样直接看屏幕、敲键盘点鼠标（原生界面控制）。此前工作常顾此失彼——能操作键鼠的只能做短任务，能规划长任务的却靠调用环境 API 或预定义技能，等于“作弊”。

2) 方法：作者把系统分成上下两层。上层“编排器”用结构化记忆记录已做到哪一步，再由视觉语言模型（VLM）规划器挑选下一个子任务，且只挑底层 VLA 确实会做的任务；为判断子任务是否完成，设计了与策略耦合的完成状态检测器，参考 VLA 自身上下文触发完成信号。下层是单个 VLA，仅凭画面输入直接输出键盘鼠标动作；由于 GUI 操作与游戏内操作风格迥异、易互相干扰，网络中加入分模式的归一化分支和单独的鼠标移动 token。

3) 训练：先注入世界知识，再做模仿学习，最后用环境反馈做强化学习，让智能体出错后能恢复。

4) 结果：在 MineStudio Bench 原子任务上得分 85.0%，在 OpenHA 上平均成功率 37.4%，并能像玩家一样从零砍树挖矿一路造出铁镐。

5) 意义：它把“看得懂、会规划、真动手”三件事缝合进一个原生键鼠接口的开放世界，为通用游戏智能体与具身智能体提供了可复用范式。

rm.usage: Minecraft 里靠键鼠操作的长时程具身智能体，与 RoboMaster 的云台自瞄、导航决策等任务形态差别很大，分层规划+能力感知的思路至多对哨兵长时程任务编排有一点点启发，实操上基本用不上。

items.title_en: RynnUnify: Towards Unified Embodied Brain
items.title_zh: RynnUnify：迈向统一的具身大脑
items.abstract_en: We introduce RynnUnify, a 16B unified embodied model that combines strong embodied understanding with long-horizon visual planning through interleaved video--language reasoning. With capabilities spanning spatial reasoning, physical prediction, and grounding, RynnUnify connects an understanding of the physical world with visual anticipation of how it evolves across successive subtasks. Building on these capabilities, we further develop an agentic extension through reinforcement learning to selectively use video predictions for reasoning about unobserved states and interaction outcomes. We also develop a world-action extension of the full RynnUnify model, translating its understanding and prediction capabilities into robot control. To evaluate these capabilities, we introduce Rynn-VP and Rynn-GEU for long-horizon visual planning and anticipatory reasoning. Experiments show that RynnUnify achieves the highest average embodied understanding score among the evaluated unified multimodal models and improves the Rynn-VP overall score by 9.75 points over Cosmos 3 Nano. Its agentic extension improves the Rynn-GEU average by 6.0 points over direct reasoning, while the world-action extension achieves 51.5\% success on 20 selected composite RoboCasa365 tasks and 46.7\% average success across three real-robot tasks. Together, these results establish RynnUnify as a shared foundation for embodied understanding, visual planning, and robot control, taking a step toward a unified embodied brain.
items.abstract_zh: 我们提出 RynnUnify，一个 16B 的统一具身模型，通过交错的视频—语言推理把强具身理解与长时程视觉规划结合起来。其能力涵盖空间推理、物理预测与 grounding，将理解物理世界与预判世界如何随子任务演变的视觉能力连接起来。在此基础上，我们通过强化学习开发了智能体式扩展，使其选择性使用视频预测推理未观测状态与交互结果；并开发了世界—动作扩展，把理解与预测能力转化为机器人控制。我们还提出 Rynn-VP 与 Rynn-GEU 两个基准，分别评估长时程视觉规划与前瞻推理。实验显示，RynnUnify 在所评估的统一多模态模型中具身理解平均得分最高，Rynn-VP 总分比 Cosmos 3 Nano 高 9.75 分；智能体扩展使 Rynn-GEU 平均分比直接推理提高 6.0 分；世界—动作扩展在 20 个选定 RoboCasa365 复合任务上成功率 51.5%，在三个真实机器人任务上平均成功率 46.7%。
items.highlight_zh: 16B 统一具身模型：理解、视频预测与机器人控制共用一个大脑
items.digest_zh:
1) 要解决的问题：机器人在真实世界干活，需要“看懂世界”和“预判接下来会怎样”两套能力，但现有模型往往只擅长其一。作者想造一个“统一具身大脑”，把理解、预测与控制装进同一个模型。

2) 方法：RynnUnify 参数量 16B，用交错的视频—语言序列做推理，也就是一边生成未来画面、一边用语言进行推理。它具备空间推理、物理预测以及 grounding（把语言指到画面中的具体物体）等能力。在此基础上作者做了两个扩展：一是用强化学习训练“智能体式”用法，让模型自己决定何时调用视频预测来推断看不到的状态和交互后果；二是“世界—动作”扩展，把理解与预测能力接到机器人动作上。

3) 评测：现有基准不够用，作者新建了 Rynn-VP（长时程视觉规划）与 Rynn-GEU（前瞻推理）。

4) 结果：在同类统一多模态模型中具身理解平均分最高；Rynn-VP 总分比 Cosmos 3 Nano 高 9.75 分；智能体式扩展让 Rynn-GEU 平均分提升 6.0 分；世界—动作版本在 20 个 RoboCasa365 复合任务上成功率为 51.5%，三个真实机器人任务平均成功率为 46.7%。

5) 意义：说明“先想清楚未来画面、再决定怎么动”的路线在统一模型里可行，为理解—规划—控制一体的具身基础模型提供了雏形。

rm.usage: 统一的视频-语言具身大脑与长时程视觉规划，可借鉴到哨兵机器人或多机战术决策的“预测对手未来状态+选子任务”设计，但模型规模 16B、面向机械臂控制，直接迁移到 RM 不现实。
rm.task: 哨兵机器人自主导航与决策

items.title_en: DiscoDemo: Discovering Efficient and Diverse Robot Demonstrations for Imitation Learning
items.title_zh: DiscoDemo：为模仿学习发现高效且多样的机器人演示
items.abstract_en: Behavior cloning for robotic manipulation is highly sensitive to the coverage of its training data, yet collecting diverse successful demonstrations remains costly. We study reinforcement learning (RL) not as a deployable controller, but as a data generator for downstream visuomotor imitation learning. Our key premise is that multiple successful solution modes cover a broader range of successful trajectories than repeatedly collecting a single narrow solution. We introduce DiscoDemo, which trains a privileged latent-conditioned RL generator with a parallel reverse curriculum and a success-gated diversity objective to discover diverse solutions while preserving task success. The trained generator produces multiple successful closed-loop behaviors, which are safety-filtered and exported as a static dataset for downstream imitation learning. Across four manipulation tasks, DiscoDemo produces broader successful-state coverage and improves downstream visuomotor policies in both simulation and the real world. Averaged across tasks, downstream success increases to 62% from 40% for the strongest baseline in simulation, and to 78% from 39% on the real robot, respectively. These results suggest that successful solution diversity improves imitation learning for a pretrained flow-matching VLA and remains complementary to corrective data collection. Project page: https://davian-robotics.github.io/DiscoDemo
items.abstract_zh: 机器人操作的行为克隆对训练数据的覆盖度高度敏感，而收集多样的成功演示代价高昂。本文不把强化学习（RL）当作可部署的控制器，而是作为下游视觉-运动模仿学习的数据生成器。核心前提是：多个成功的解法模式比反复采集单一狭窄解法能覆盖更广的成功轨迹。我们提出 DiscoDemo，训练一个带特权潜在条件、使用并行逆向课程与成功门控多样性目标的 RL 生成器，在保持任务成功的前提下发现多样解法。生成器产生多种成功的闭环行为，经安全过滤后导出为静态数据集供下游模仿学习使用。在四个操作任务上，DiscoDemo 带来更广的成功状态覆盖，并在仿真与真实世界中提升下游视觉-运动策略：仿真中最强基线平均成功率 40% 提升至 62%，真实机器人上由 39% 提升至 78%。结果表明，成功解法的多样性可改善预训练 flow-matching VLA 的模仿学习，并与纠正性数据采集互补。
items.highlight_zh: 用 RL 当数据生成器，多样性演示让 VLA 成功率大幅提升
items.digest_zh:
1. 研究问题：训练机器人模仿学习（行为克隆）时，数据是否覆盖足够多的成功方式，直接决定策略好坏；但人工收集多样演示昂贵，只重复采集同一种做法又会让策略过于狭窄。
2. 方法思路：作者不把强化学习当作最终控制器，而是当作“演示生产机”。DiscoDemo 训练一个带特权信息的潜在条件 RL 生成器，用并行逆向课程加速学习，并加入“成功门控的多样性”目标——只有仍然完成任务的行为才被计入多样性，从而在保证成功的同时找到多种不同解法。生成的多条闭环行为经安全过滤后，导出一个静态数据集。
3. 实验结果：在四个操作任务上，生成的演示覆盖了更广的成功状态；用这些数据训练下游视觉-运动策略，仿真平均成功率从最强基线的 40% 升到 62%，真实机器人从 39% 升到 78%。
4. 为何重要：它说明“成功方式的多样性”本身就是一种可扩展的数据增强手段，且与人工纠正数据互补，为降低机器人数据采集成本提供了新路径。

rm.usage: 可借鉴其「RL 只作数据生成器」的思路：在仿真里为工程机器人机械臂装配/取弹任务并行探索多种成功轨迹，导出成数据集再训练视觉-运动策略，提升策略对位姿偏差的鲁棒性。但论文面向桌面操作，迁移到 RM 需重写任务与奖励，实用度有限。

items.title_en: AV-FABLE: Audio-Visual Manipulation Forensics in Long-Form Videos
items.title_zh: AV-FABLE：长视频中的音视频操作取证
items.abstract_en: Localized AI manipulations in long-form videos often affect brief events within otherwise authentic content, making video-level classification insufficient for forensic analysis. Existing audio-visual deepfake benchmarks largely focus on short talking-head clips, while long-form temporal forensics remains predominantly visual. We introduce AV-FABLE, a dual-timeline benchmark for sparse manipulations in open-scene long-form audio-visual videos. AV-FABLE contains 16,650 pristine--manipulated twin pairs (998 hours) created with 27 editing configurations, with separate audio and visual timelines that enable modality-specific temporal localization and expose errors hidden by joint-timeline evaluation. On AV-FABLE, zero-shot prompting of audio-visual large language models (AV-LLMs) yields near-chance detection and poor temporal localization. In contrast, supervised readouts of their frozen perception features recover strong forensic signals, suggesting manipulation evidence is encoded in these representations but not effectively exposed through language outputs. Motivated by this observation, we propose NFSR(Native Forensics via Separated Readouts), which reads frozen AV-LLM features with separate audio and visual temporal decoders. NFSR achieves the best audio-visual localization performance in-domain and across all three out-of-distribution settings, including transfer to held-out videos from an external long-video forensic benchmark. AV-FABLE, code, and model weights will be publicly released.
items.abstract_zh: 长视频中局部的 AI 篡改往往只影响真实内容中的短暂事件，因此视频级分类不足以支撑取证分析。现有音视频深度伪造基准多聚焦短视频说话人片段，长视频时序取证也以视觉为主。我们提出 AV-FABLE，一个面向开放场景长视频稀疏篡改的双时间线基准，包含 16,650 对原始—篡改孪生样本（998 小时），由 27 种编辑配置生成，音频与视觉时间线相互独立，从而支持分模态的时序定位，并暴露联合时间线评测所掩盖的错误。在 AV-FABLE 上，零样本提示音视频大语言模型（AV-LLM）的检测接近随机、时序定位很差；相反，对其冻结感知特征做有监督读出则能恢复强取证信号，说明篡改证据已编码在这些表征中，却未被语言输出有效暴露。据此我们提出 NFSR，用分离的音频与视觉时序解码器读取冻结 AV-LLM 特征，在域内及全部三种分布外设置（含迁移到外部长视频取证基准的留出视频）上取得最佳音视频定位性能。AV-FABLE、代码与模型权重将公开。
items.highlight_zh: 首个长视频音视频双时间线篡改基准，并提出 NFSR 读出法
items.digest_zh:
1. 研究问题：长视频里的 AI 篡改常常只改几秒钟的片段，判断“整段视频真假”远远不够，需要精确指出改在哪、什么时候改。但现有音视频伪造数据集基本是短视频说话人片段，长视频取证也主要看画面，声音被忽视。
2. 数据构建：作者推出 AV-FABLE，专门针对开放场景长视频中的稀疏篡改。它包含 16,650 对“原片—篡改片”，共 998 小时，用 27 种编辑方式生成；关键在于音频和视觉各有一条独立时间线，可分别评测定位能力，也揭示出用单一联合时间线评测会掩盖的错误。
3. 发现与方法：测试发现，直接让音视频大模型（AV-LLM）零样本判断，检测几乎靠猜、定位很差；但若把这些模型冻结的感知特征拿出来做有监督读出，就能得到很强的取证信号——说明模型内部“知道”哪里被改，只是语言输出没说出来。受此启发，作者提出 NFSR，用音频、视觉两个独立时序解码器读取冻结特征。
4. 结果与意义：NFSR 在域内和三种分布外设置（包括迁移到外部长视频取证基准）上均取得最佳音视频定位表现，为长视频音视频取证提供了新基准与新范式。
items.comment: 41 pages, 10 figures, including appendices

rm.usage: 长视频音视频深度伪造的时序定位与取证，与 RoboMaster 的自瞄、导航、决策等环节基本无关，赛事中也没有伪造检测需求，关联很弱。

items.title_en: RynnVLA-Latent: Scaling Robotic Manipulation Foundation Models with 3D-Grounded Latent Actions
items.title_zh: RynnVLA-Latent：用三维接地的潜在动作扩展机器人操作基础模型
items.abstract_en: Scaling vision-language-action (VLA) models is constrained by scarce action-labeled demonstrations and incompatible control spaces across robot embodiments. We present RynnVLA-Latent, a framework that turns heterogeneous interaction videos into scalable supervision for robot policy pretraining. At its core, RynnLAM learns continuous, 3D-grounded latent actions from visual transitions without requiring native robot controls. By combining residual future-feature prediction, camera-compensated 3D-flow supervision, and camera-motion decoupling, RynnLAM encourages representations that capture control-relevant motion rather than appearance changes alone. We apply RynnLAM to 30.1K hours of human, robot, and simulation videos, producing 745.52M latent-action descriptors. RynnVLA-Latent then learns to predict latent-action chunks from visual observations and language through flow matching, before adapting its pretrained backbone and action expert to embodiment-specific robot actions. The resulting 4B policy achieves 98.8% success on LIBERO, 84.7% on LIBERO-Plus without benchmark-specific adaptation, 51.9% average success across five VLABench tracks, and 88.6% average success on the RoboTwin 2.0 bimanual benchmark. It also achieves the highest observed success rates among the compared methods on six real-world manipulation tasks across dexterous-hand and mobile-gripper platforms. Together with representation ablations and data-scaling results, these findings demonstrate the potential of latent-action supervision for scaling robot policy learning beyond native action-labeled data.
items.abstract_zh: 扩展视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型受限于带动作标注的演示稀缺，以及不同机器人本体控制空间不兼容。我们提出 RynnVLA-Latent，将异构交互视频转化为可扩展的机器人策略预训练监督。其核心 RynnLAM 无需原生机器人控制信号，即可从视觉变化中学习连续、三维接地的潜在动作；通过结合残差未来特征预测、相机补偿的三维光流监督与相机运动解耦，RynnLAM 促使表征捕捉与控制相关的运动而非仅外观变化。我们将 RynnLAM 应用于 30.1K 小时的人类、机器人与仿真视频，生成 7.4552 亿条潜在动作描述子。随后，RynnVLA-Latent 通过 flow matching 从视觉观测与语言预测潜在动作块，再将预训练主干与动作专家适配到具体本体的机器人动作。所得 4B 策略在 LIBERO 上达 98.8% 成功率，在无需基准特定适配的 LIBERO-Plus 上达 84.7%，在 VLABench 五条赛道平均 51.9%，在 RoboTwin 2.0 双臂基准上平均 88.6%；在灵巧手与移动夹爪平台上的六个真实操作任务中也取得对比方法中最高的成功率。结合表征消融与数据规模实验，这些结果表明潜在动作监督有望让机器人策略学习突破原生动作标注数据的限制。
items.highlight_zh: 从 3 万小时视频学三维潜在动作，4B 模型多基准领先
items.digest_zh:
1. 研究问题：视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型想做大，却卡在两件事：带动作标签的机器人演示太少；不同机器人（机械臂、灵巧手、移动底盘）的动作空间互不兼容，难以共享数据。
2. 方法核心：作者提出 RynnVLA-Latent，把大量异构交互视频变成预训练监督。关键模块 RynnLAM 不需要机器人原生控制信号，只从画面变化中学习连续、三维接地的“潜在动作”。它同时用三招：预测残差的未来特征、用相机补偿后的三维光流做监督、把相机自身运动解耦出去，从而让学到的表征关注“控制相关的运动”而非单纯外观变化。
3. 规模与训练：作者把 RynnLAM 跑在 30.1K 小时的人类、机器人、仿真视频上，产出约 7.46 亿条潜在动作描述子。RynnVLA-Latent 先用 flow matching 从视觉观测和语言预测潜在动作块，再把预训练主干和动作专家适配到具体本体的真实动作上，得到 4B 参数策略。
4. 结果与意义：LIBERO 上 98.8%、无需专门适配的 LIBERO-Plus 上 84.7%、VLABench 五赛道平均 51.9%、RoboTwin 2.0 双臂平均 88.6%，并在灵巧手与移动夹爪的真实任务中成功率居首。说明用潜在动作做监督，能突破“必须有原生动作标注”的数据瓶颈。
items.comment: Project page: https://alibaba-damo-academy.github.io/RynnVLA-Latent.github.io/, GitHub: https://github.com/alibaba-damo-academy/RynnVLA-Latent

rm.usage: 其「从无动作标注视频中学习三维接地潜在动作、再适配到具体本体」的路线，可用于工程机器人机械臂操作的预训练，缓解 RM 装配数据稀缺问题；但当前只验证了桌面操作任务，短期难直接落地到赛场。

items.title_en: Learning Scene Coordinate Reconstruction from Unposed Images via Pose Graph Optimization
items.title_zh: 通过位姿图优化从未标定图像中学习场景坐标重建
items.abstract_en: Learning-based structure-from-motion methods such as ACE-Zero have demonstrated strong performance in estimating cameraposes and scene coordinates from unordered image collections without requiring ground truth supervision. However, the lack of global and multi-view consistency constraints in ACE-Zero can lead to pose drift and misalignment, particularly in complex or ambiguous scenes. In this work, we propose a hybrid framework that integrates pose graph optimization (PGO) into ACE-Zero to refine camera poses and suppress incorrect refinements. We construct pose graphs directly from ACE-Zero outputs by extracting relative pose constraints from predicted scene coordinates. Furthermore, we introduce an uncertainty-aware optimization strategy by estimating confidence scores using geometric priors, including epipolar and optical flow consistencies across views. Our approach improves the robustness and accuracy of pose estimation, demonstrating that global geometric reasoning can effectively complement learning-based inference in structure-from-motion.
items.abstract_zh: 基于学习的 structure-from-motion 方法（如 ACE-Zero）无需真值监督即可从无序图像集合中估计相机位姿与场景坐标，但缺乏全局与多视图一致性约束，在复杂或歧义场景中易产生位姿漂移与错位。本文提出混合框架，将位姿图优化（PGO）融入 ACE-Zero 以精化相机位姿并抑制错误修正。作者直接从 ACE-Zero 输出中提取相对位姿约束构建位姿图，并引入不确定性感知优化策略，利用对极几何与跨视图光流一致性等几何先验估计置信度分数。该方法提升了位姿估计的鲁棒性与精度，表明全局几何推理能有效补充 structure-from-motion 中基于学习的推断。
items.highlight_zh: 用位姿图优化为学习式SfM补上全局一致性
items.digest_zh:
研究问题：ACE-Zero 这类学习式 structure-from-motion 方法，能从一堆无序、未标定的照片里直接回归相机位姿和场景坐标，无需真值标注；但它逐帧推断，缺少全局与多视图一致性，复杂或歧义场景里位姿会漂移、重建会错位。
方法：作者做一个混合框架，把经典的位姿图优化（PGO）接在 ACE-Zero 之后：从网络预测的场景坐标反推帧与帧之间的相对位姿约束，搭成位姿图做全局优化来校正漂移。同时引入不确定性感知——用对极几何一致性、跨视图光流一致性等几何先验给每条约束打置信度，让不可靠的边权重降低，抑制“越修越错”。
结果：位姿估计的精度与鲁棒性均有提升，在复杂场景中更稳定。
意义：这不是用几何方法取代学习，而是让学习负责局部预测、几何优化负责全局一致，二者互补；这一“学习+优化”组合对无监督三维重建以及 SLAM、AR 等需要稳健位姿的应用有借鉴价值。
items.comment: Accepted to CVPR 2026 (Highlight). Project page: https://eldentse.github.io/visual_localization_pgo_public/

rm.usage: 可用于赛前用手机/相机环绕拍摄场地或机器人本体，重建场景坐标与相机位姿，为仿真环境搭建或哨兵视觉重定位提供点云/位姿初值；但在已知固定场地中直接做PGO的必要性不大，属于离线辅助工具。

items.title_en: Revisiting Direct Control: A Field Evaluation of Sensor Fusion Efficacy in Teleoperating Full-Scale Autonomous Vehicles via Bird's Eye View
items.title_zh: 重访直接控制：全尺寸自动驾驶车辆鸟瞰图遥操作中传感器融合效能的实地评估
items.abstract_en: In autonomous driving, robot teleoperation serves as a critical safety fallback mechanism, requiring operators to assume direct control in the event of system failure. While recent research has pivoted toward high-level supervisory control or simulation-based studies, these approaches often fail to capture the physical dynamics and sensory demands of driving a full-scale vehicle. To address this gap, we evaluated the impact of spatial data representation on operator performance using a real car-sized vehicle in a field experiment with $N = 18$ participants. We compared three visualization interfaces: (i) a standard camera feed baseline, with two bird's-eye views (BEV) from (ii) a raw LiDAR point cloud, and (iii) a sensor fusion of LiDAR and camera data streams. Contrary to prior passive observation studies suggesting that sensor-fusion BEV may hinder awareness, our active-control results demonstrate that such representation significantly outperforms the standard LiDAR BEV in perceived usability ($p \leq 0.0001$) and cognitive task load ($p = 0.01$, NASA-TLX score: 34.58/100) while also being significantly better than the Camera-only view ($p = 0.043$). The fused interface also led to statistically significant reductions in task completion time ($p = 0.0461$) and superior usability (SUS: 77.9/100) compared to those of the Camera-only and LiDAR-only views. By synthesizing objective performance data with comprehensive subjective assessments, we demonstrate that BEV fusion maximizes safety margins while minimizing the operator's mental demand. These findings challenge existing teleoperation conventions and provide an empirically validated approach for designing robust remote piloting systems.
items.abstract_zh: 在自动驾驶中，遥操作是关键的失效安全兜底手段，要求操作员在系统故障时直接接管车辆。近期研究多转向高层监督控制或仿真实验，难以反映驾驶全尺寸车辆的物理动力学与感知需求。为此，作者用真实车尺寸车辆开展实地实验（N=18），比较三种可视化界面：标准摄像头画面、原始 LiDAR 点云鸟瞰图（BEV）、以及 LiDAR 与相机融合的 BEV。与既往被动观察研究认为融合 BEV 可能削弱态势感知不同，主动控制结果显示融合表征在感知可用性（p≤0.0001）与认知负荷（p=0.01，NASA-TLX 34.58/100）上显著优于纯 LiDAR BEV，也显著优于纯相机视图（p=0.043），并显著缩短任务完成时间（p=0.0461），可用性最佳（SUS 77.9/100）。
items.highlight_zh: 实车实验显示LiDAR-相机融合BEV遥操作表现最佳
items.digest_zh:
研究问题：自动驾驶系统出故障时要有人远程接管，即遥操作兜底。此前不少研究在仿真里做，或只让被试“看”而不真正“开”，结论可能失真：真实车辆的动力学和操作员感官负担完全不同。到底给操作员看什么画面最利于安全接管？
方法：作者用一辆真实车尺寸的车辆做实地实验，18 名被试实际远程驾驶，比较三种界面：普通摄像头画面、原始 LiDAR 点云的鸟瞰图（BEV）、以及 LiDAR 与相机融合的 BEV，并测量客观绩效与主观指标（任务完成时间、SUS 可用性、NASA-TLX 认知负荷）。
结果：与“融合 BEV 会让人看不清”的旧印象相反，主动控制下融合视图最好：感知可用性显著优于纯 LiDAR（p≤0.0001）与纯相机（p=0.043）；认知负荷最低（NASA-TLX 34.58/100，p=0.01）；任务完成更快（p=0.0461），SUS 达 77.9/100。
意义：说明人机界面必须在真实控制任务中评估；融合 BEV 能在降低脑力负担的同时扩大安全裕度，为远程接管系统的界面设计提供了实证依据。
items.comment: Accepted at 2026 IEEE/RSJ International Conference on Intelligent Robots and Systems (IROS)

rm.usage: 与RM赛场上机器人全自主运行的模式差异较大（RM无遥操作环节），仅在实验室远程调试/接管工程机器人或飞镖站时有一点人机界面参考价值，核心结论难以迁移。

items.title_en: Sparse Recovery Bird's-Eye View Model Soup for Robust Camera-Based 3D Object Detection
items.title_zh: 稀疏恢复鸟瞰图模型汤：面向鲁棒的基于相机的 3D 目标检测
items.abstract_en: Camera-based bird's-eye view (BEV) perception methods such as Fast-BEV have demonstrated promising results with fast inference speed and competitive accuracy. However, their robustness to real-world corruptions remains insufficiently explored, posing risks for autonomous driving deployment where environmental variations are inevitable. In this paper, we propose Sparse Recovery Bird's-Eye View Model Soup (SR-BEVS), a sparse recovery learning approach that simultaneously improves clean accuracy and corruption robustness without requiring additional data or architectural modifications. Our method identifies pruning candidates based on layer-wise weight magnitudes, applies random pruning to create diverse sparse models, and retrains each model with a randomly sampled learning rate. By averaging these diverse recovered models into a single dense model, we achieve enhanced robustness against various corruptions while introducing zero inference overhead. We further provide a mode connectivity analysis demonstrating that our pruning-based diversification preserves the connected low-loss basin necessary for stable weight averaging. Experiments on the nuScenes dataset demonstrate up to 33.8% improvement in corruption robustness and a 1.8% gain in clean accuracy over the Fast-BEV baseline, with consistent improvements across sensor noise, weather distortions, and illumination changes. Our simple yet effective approach may be applicable to other BEV models.
items.abstract_zh: 基于相机的鸟瞰图（BEV）感知方法（如 Fast-BEV）推理快、精度有竞争力，但其对真实世界图像退化的鲁棒性研究不足，给自动驾驶部署带来风险。本文提出稀疏恢复 BEV 模型汤（SR-BEVS），一种稀疏恢复学习方法，无需额外数据或改动网络结构即可同时提升干净精度与退化鲁棒性。方法按逐层权重幅值确定剪枝候选，随机剪枝生成多样稀疏模型，并以随机采样的学习率分别重训练，再将这些模型平均为单一稠密模型，实现零推理开销的鲁棒性增强。模式连接性分析表明，基于剪枝的多样化保留了稳定权重平均所需的连通低损失盆地。在 nuScenes 上，退化鲁棒性最高提升 33.8%，干净精度提升 1.8%。
items.highlight_zh: 随机剪枝再恢复并做权重平均，零开销提鲁棒性
items.digest_zh:
研究问题：基于相机的 BEV 感知（如 Fast-BEV）又快又准，但现实中的雨雾、噪声、光照突变会让它明显退化，这类鲁棒性研究不足，直接影响自动驾驶落地安全。
方法：作者提出 SR-BEVS，不需额外数据，也不改网络结构。思路是：按各层权重幅值挑出可剪枝的部分，随机剪枝得到一批结构各异的稀疏子模型；每个子模型用随机采样的学习率单独重训练（“恢复”）；最后把这些权重平均成一个稠密模型，即“模型汤”。推理时只用这一个模型，零额外开销。
结果：在 nuScenes 上，相比 Fast-BEV 基线，抗退化鲁棒性最高提升 33.8%，干净精度还涨了 1.8%，在传感器噪声、天气畸变、光照变化下均稳定获益。作者用模式连接性分析解释：基于剪枝的多样化让不同解落在同一个连通的低损失盆地，权重平均才稳定有效。
意义：提供一种“多花训练算力换鲁棒性”的简单通用方法，并可能迁移到其他 BEV 模型。
items.comment: Accepted to IROS 2026. 8 pages, 6 figures

rm.usage: 可把这类剪枝模型汤的鲁棒化思路用在雷达场端相机做BEV多目标检测上，提升在强光、逆光、场地灯光变化下的检出稳定性；但需自建RM数据集并改造为BEV检测头，属于二次开发。
rm.task: 雷达目标探测与信息融合

items.title_en: HoloBoxing: A Simple Recipe for Humanoid Boxing with 7 Minutes of Single-GPU Training
items.title_zh: HoloBoxing：单 GPU 训练 7 分钟的人形机器人拳击简易配方
items.abstract_en: HoloBoxing presents a simple recipe for learning humanoid boxing by building on a pretrained whole-body controller. The recipe separates reusable motor skills from task decisions: a compact planner requests future body-point targets, while the frozen controller handles joint-level execution. A learned decoder maps 32-dimensional actions to structured target windows, and measured-state imitation initializes the planner before reinforcement learning. Task learning then refines interaction behavior while reusing the decoder and controller, avoiding the need to relearn whole-body control. This combination keeps task optimization focused on a compact upper policy and supplies an initial behavior before reward-driven exploration. Starting from that available controller, the recipe accounts for about seven minutes of additional training, including reused representation fitting and a single-GPU task run. This excludes controller pretraining, data preparation, evaluation, and search. Simulated boxing experiments and component controls evaluate the resulting behavior and the roles of imitation initialization and the target representation.
items.abstract_zh: HoloBoxing 提出一种基于预训练全身控制器的人形机器人拳击学习配方。该配方把可复用的运动技能与任务决策分离：一个紧凑的规划器输出未来身体点目标，冻结的控制器负责关节级执行。一个学习到的解码器把 32 维动作映射为结构化目标窗口，先用实测状态模仿来初始化规划器，再用强化学习细化交互行为，全程复用解码器与控制器，无需重新学习全身控制。这一组合使任务优化集中于紧凑的上层策略，并在奖励驱动的探索前提供初始行为。在已有控制器基础上，该配方只需约七分钟额外训练（含复用表征拟合与单 GPU 任务运行），不含控制器预训练、数据准备、评估与搜索。仿真拳击实验与组件对照实验评估了所得行为，以及模仿初始化与目标表征的作用。
items.highlight_zh: 解耦运动与决策，7 分钟单卡训练出人形拳击策略
items.digest_zh:
1) 问题：训练人形机器人打拳击这类需要全身协调的动作，通常要在仿真里从头学习全身控制，代价高、周期长。作者问：能不能把“会动”和“会打”拆开，让任务学习变得极轻量？

2) 方法：HoloBoxing 复用已有的预训练全身控制器并冻结它，只训练一个紧凑的上层规划器。规划器输出 32 维动作，经一个学到的解码器映射为结构化的身体目标点窗口，再由冻结控制器转成关节指令。训练分两步：先用实测状态做模仿，给规划器一个靠谱的起点；再用强化学习优化交互行为。解码器与控制器全程复用，不必重新学习全身控制。

3) 结果：在已有控制器前提下，任务训练只需约 7 分钟单 GPU 时间（含表征拟合与一次任务运行）；作者明确排除了控制器预训练、数据准备、评估与超参搜索的耗时。仿真拳击实验加消融对照，验证了行为有效，并说明模仿初始化与目标表征各自的作用。

4) 意义：它提示了一条“技能复用 + 轻量任务适配”的机器人学习流水线：底层运动能力一次训好反复使用，上层任务策略几分钟就能训出来，显著降低新任务门槛。

rm.usage: 人形机器人拳击的上层规划器+冻结全身控制器分离训练配方，与 RM 的轮式底盘/云台控制体系不同，仅其“紧凑上层策略+复用底层控制器”的训练范式对强化学习仿真有参考价值。

items.title_en: AdaDexTrack: Dynamic Modulation for Adaptive and Generalizable Dexterous Manipulation Tracking
items.title_zh: AdaDexTrack：用于自适应与可泛化灵巧操作跟踪的动态调制
items.abstract_en: Language is a natural way to command robots, but converting a single instruction into a long-horizon, contact-rich hand-object interaction remains challenging: synthesized references are noisy, human-to-robot retargeting introduces embodiment bias, and fixed-reference tracking lets small errors snowball. We address this with AdaDexTrack, a modulator-in-the-loop framework for language-conditioned manipulation tracking. A distilled generalist tracker serves as the skill carrier, while a tightly aligned modulator performs three feedback corrections: reference modulation (continual adjustment of what to track), object-latent modulation (online adaptation of the object representation to recruit suitable skills), and positional-target modulation (small state-dependent refinements for execution). The tracker is learned via large-scale specialist to generalist distillation on a corpus of language-conditioned hand-object trajectories; the modulator is trained with RL under the same task objective, ensuring tight coupling. Across large-scale evaluations, AdaDexTrack consistently outperforms prior SOTA on unseen-trajectory and unseen-object sets in both average tracking error and success rate, demonstrating robustness and generalization. We further show zero-shot sim-to-real transfer on real hardware, where adding the modulator yields substantial gains over a tracker-only variant. AdaDexTrack reframes language-conditioned dexterous manipulation as modulated tracking, replacing the open-loop, fixed-reference tracking with in-loop modulation that adjusts the reference, object latent, and positional target, yielding drift-resistant execution from noisy text references.
items.abstract_zh: 用语言指令驱动机器人很自然，但要把单条指令变成长期、接触丰富的手-物交互仍很困难：合成的参考轨迹有噪声，人到机器人的重定向会引入具身偏差，固定参考跟踪还会让微小误差不断累积。为此提出 AdaDexTrack，一个「调制器在环」的语言条件操作跟踪框架：以蒸馏得到的通才跟踪器作为技能载体，由与之紧密对齐的调制器执行三类反馈修正——参考调制、物体隐变量调制和位置目标调制。跟踪器通过大规模「专家到通才」蒸馏获得，调制器在同一任务目标下用强化学习训练。大规模评测中，该方法在未见轨迹与未见物体集合上于平均跟踪误差和成功率两方面均稳定超越此前最优方法，并在真实硬件上实现零样本 sim-to-real 迁移。该工作把语言条件灵巧操作重构为受调制的跟踪，用在线闭环调制替代开环固定参考跟踪以抵抗漂移。
items.highlight_zh: 用在线调制替代固定参考跟踪，抑制漂移并泛化到新物体
items.digest_zh:
1）研究了什么问题：如何让机器人仅凭一句自然语言指令，完成较长时间、手与物体频繁接触的灵巧操作。论文指出三个关键障碍：自动合成的参考动作本身带有噪声；把人的动捕数据「重定向」到机器人手上会产生具身差异（embodiment bias）；而传统做法是死盯一条固定参考轨迹做跟踪，微小偏差会随时间不断放大，最终导致任务失败。
2）用了什么方法：提出 AdaDexTrack，核心思想是「调制器在环」（modulator-in-the-loop）。系统里有一个通才跟踪器作为技能载体，它是先把大量专门技能通过大规模蒸馏压缩得到的。另有一个与跟踪器紧密对齐的调制器，在三个层面实时纠偏：一是参考调制，动态决定此刻到底该跟踪什么；二是物体隐变量调制，在线调整对物体状态的内部表征，以便调用合适的技能；三是位置目标调制，按当前状态对执行目标做小幅微调。调制器不是事后补丁，而是在与任务完全相同的目标下用强化学习训练，因此和跟踪器耦合得很紧。
3）有什么结果：在未见过的参考轨迹和未见过的物体上，平均跟踪误差和成功率都稳定优于此前的最好方法；还把系统零样本迁移到真实机器人硬件上，加入调制器比只有跟踪器的版本提升明显。
4）为何重要：它把「语言→灵巧操作」重新定义为一个带反馈的跟踪问题，让系统不再依赖一条精确的参考轨迹，而是边走边修，因而对噪声指令更鲁棒，也更容易泛化到新物体并落地到真机。
items.comment: CVPR 2026. 18 pages, 14 figures, including supplementary material. Project page: https://janebek.github.io/AdaDexTrack/

rm.usage: 其“调制器在环”在线修正参考轨迹的思路可借鉴到工程机器人视觉装配（能量单元/发射机构对接），用视觉反馈在线修正机械臂末端轨迹以抵抗标定漂移；但方法面向灵巧手与语言指令，直接迁移成本高。

items.title_en: Multi-Objective Reinforcement Learning Using Routed Ensembles and Trajectory Attribution
items.title_zh: 基于路由集成与轨迹归因的多目标强化学习
items.abstract_en: Multi-objective reinforcement learning is a fundamental problem for modern AI, with applications spanning post-training, reasoning models, and robotic control. A central challenge is to learn policies that balance competing objectives, such as helpfulness versus honesty in safety and alignment, or speed versus energy in robotics. The optimal policy can vary sharply with objective-weighting combinations, and the extent of this variation depends crucially on the degree of conflict among objectives, making per-preference policy learning sample-inefficient. In this paper, we introduce objective-conflict coefficients and derive near-optimal regret bounds for online settings using this measure, thereby quantifying the impact of misalignment on learning efficiency. Then, we design routed ensemble policy learning, an algorithm that maintains a small set of basis policies and dynamically routes trajectories to the policy with the highest potential reward. Finally, we consider trajectory selection as another approach to mitigate objective conflict, and design a kernel surrogate trajectory attribution algorithm that estimates how feedback signals from a set of trajectories influence policy learning on other trajectories. The kernel can capture nonlinear interactions such as synergy and antagonism between trajectories. We evaluate our approach across diverse environments and benchmarks: routed ensembles improve average performance by 4.3% over baselines for online environments from Meta-World and MO-Gymnasium, and kernel surrogate attribution improves correlation with leave-one-out analysis over existing baselines by 50%. When applied to trajectory selection, kernel-based attribution yields a 27% improvement in reward over baseline attribution methods.
items.abstract_zh: 多目标强化学习是现代 AI 的基础问题，应用涵盖后训练、推理模型与机器人控制。核心挑战在于学习能平衡相互竞争目标的策略，例如安全对齐中的有用性与诚实性、机器人中的速度与能耗。最优策略会随目标权重组合而剧烈变化，变化幅度取决于目标间的冲突程度，因此逐偏好学习策略样本效率很低。本文引入目标冲突系数，并据此推导在线场景的近最优遗憾界，量化目标不一致对学习效率的影响。随后设计路由集成策略学习算法：维护一小组基策略，把每条轨迹动态分配给潜在回报最高的策略。最后把轨迹选择视为缓解目标冲突的另一途径，设计核代理轨迹归因算法，估计一组轨迹的反馈信号如何影响其他轨迹上的策略学习，其核函数可刻画轨迹间的协同与拮抗等非线性交互。在多种环境与基准上评测：路由集成在 Meta-World 与 MO-Gymnasium 在线环境上平均性能较基线提升 4.3%；核代理归因与留一分析的相关性较现有基线提升 50%；用于轨迹选择时，基于核的归因相比基线归因方法回报提升 27%。
items.highlight_zh: 用路由集成与核轨迹归因缓解目标冲突，提升多目标学习效率
items.digest_zh:
1）研究了什么问题：当 AI 需要同时满足多个互相竞争的目标时（如既要有用又要诚实、既要快又要省电），该怎么训练策略。难点是：目标权重稍有变化，最优行为就可能大不相同；而目标之间冲突越强，这种差异越大。若为每一种权重组合都单独训练一个策略，样本效率极低。
2）理论部分：论文定义了「目标冲突系数」，并针对在线学习场景推导出接近最优的遗憾界（regret bound），从而定量说明目标之间「不对齐」会让学习效率损失多少。这为后续算法设计提供了依据。
3）方法部分：其一是路由集成策略学习——只维护一小组基策略，然后根据潜在回报把每条轨迹动态路由给最合适的那个策略，避免为每个偏好从头学；其二是核代理轨迹归因——把「挑哪些轨迹」也当作缓解冲突的手段，用核函数估计某条轨迹的反馈信号会如何影响在其他轨迹上的策略学习，该核能刻画轨迹之间的协同与拮抗这类非线性关系。
4）结果：在 Meta-World 与 MO-Gymnasium 等在线环境中，路由集成比基线平均性能提升 4.3%；核代理归因与留一法（leave-one-out）分析的相关性比现有基线高 50%，说明它更准确地刻画了轨迹影响力；把它用于轨迹选择时，回报比基线归因方法高 27%。
5）为何重要：它同时从「策略组织」和「数据选择」两个角度处理多目标冲突，给出了可量化的理论刻画和实用的样本高效方案，对模型后训练、对齐安全以及机器人控制等需要权衡多个指标的场景都有直接参考价值。
items.comment: 30 pages. To appear at NeurIPS 2026 (extended version)

rm.usage: 可把“弹丸消耗 vs 输出伤害”“抢增益 vs 保生存”等多目标权衡形式化为多目标RL，用路由集成训练一组按权重切换的哨兵/多机决策策略，提升策略对战术偏好变化的适应性；需自行设计与RM对局的奖励。

items.title_en: Echo: Coupled Action and Task Status Signal Denoising for Vision Language Action Models
items.title_zh: Echo：面向视觉—语言—动作模型的耦合动作与任务状态信号去噪
items.abstract_en: Recognizing task completion and failure enables robots to stop upon success and initiate recovery or replanning after failure. Existing methods augment Vision Language Action (VLA) policies with task status signal prediction to support these execution decisions. However, learning and integrating these signals can require fine-grained supervision, external monitoring models, or complex architectural designs. Moreover, the potential of task status signals to directly guide action generation remains underexplored. We present Echo, a framework that combines task status signal learning without frame-level progress annotations with a compact design for status prediction and action generation within a single VLA. Specifically, Echo represents task status with stop and failure signals, added as two dimensions of each action chunk and denoised together with robot actions. Their combination distinguishes ongoing execution, successful completion, and failure. To learn these signals without fine-grained progress annotations, Echo constructs successful, failed, and recovery trajectories with complementary supervision properties. To enable status signal-guided action generation, Echo controls interactions between the signals and actions and denoises the signals faster than the actions. These allow later action denoising steps to condition on cleaner status estimates while preserving accurate signal prediction. Extensive real-world manipulation experiments show that Echo accurately predicts task status and consistently improves policy performance.
items.abstract_zh: 识别任务完成与失败，能让机器人在成功时停止、失败后恢复或重规划。现有方法为 VLA 策略增加任务状态信号预测来支持这些执行决策，但学习与整合这些信号往往需要细粒度监督、外部监控模型或复杂架构，且状态信号直接引导动作生成的潜力仍未被充分挖掘。我们提出 Echo：一个无需帧级进度标注即可学习任务状态信号，并在单个 VLA 内以紧凑设计同时完成状态预测与动作生成的框架。Echo 用停止与失败信号表示任务状态，将其作为每个动作块的两个维度与机器人动作一起去噪，二者组合可区分执行中、成功完成与失败。为在无细粒度标注下学习信号，Echo 构建了具有互补监督性质的成对成功、失败与恢复轨迹；为使状态信号引导动作生成，Echo 控制信号与动作的交互，并让信号比动作更快去噪，使后续动作去噪步骤可基于更干净的状态估计，同时保持信号预测准确。大量真实机器人操作实验表明 Echo 能准确预测任务状态，并稳定提升策略性能。
items.highlight_zh: 停止/失败信号与动作一起去噪，无需进度标注即可增强 VLA
items.digest_zh:
1) 问题：机器人执行任务时若不知道自己做没做完、有没有失败，就只能一直做下去。已有做法是给 VLA（视觉—语言—动作模型）额外加一个“任务状态”预测头，但往往要帧级进度标注、外挂监控模型或复杂结构；而且这些状态信号能否反过来指导动作生成，此前没人深挖。

2) 方法：Echo 的思路很简洁——把“停止”和“失败”两个状态信号直接当作动作块里多出来的两个维度，与机器人动作一起做扩散去噪。一次前向即可同时得到动作与状态，两者组合可区分“还在做”“成功完成”“失败”。为免去帧级标注，作者构造了成功、失败、恢复三类轨迹，利用它们互补的监督性质来学习信号。更关键的是去噪节奏：让状态信号比动作去噪得更快，后续动作去噪步骤就能参考更干净的状态估计，同时不牺牲信号本身的预测精度。

3) 结果：在大量真实机器人操作实验中，Echo 能准确预测任务状态，并稳定提升策略成功率。

4) 意义：它表明任务状态不只是事后的“裁判”，还能当动作生成的“向导”；而且这种改造几乎没有额外结构成本，容易嫁接到现有 VLA 上。
items.comment: Project page: https://lyfeng001.github.io/Echo/

rm.usage: 把任务完成/失败信号与动作一起去噪、无需帧级进度标注，可迁移到工程机器人视觉装配的成功判定与失败重试逻辑（如判断模块是否装入能量单元），但需替换为 RM 的视觉伺服策略。

items.title_en: Belief-Conditioned Multi-Agent Actor Critic for Decentralized LLM Collaboration
items.title_zh: 面向去中心化LLM协作的信念条件多智能体Actor-Critic方法
items.abstract_en: Recent work has explored optimizing LLM collaboration through Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning (MARL), but many approaches still rely on predefined workflows, limiting efficiency and scalability. Decentralized LLM collaboration is challenging because agents execute independently with limited communication, share a joint objective, and must infer useful information from communication traces. In this paper, we propose BCMAAC, a Belief-Conditioned Multi-Agent Actor-Critic method that maintains beliefs over contextual information and uses them to facilitate training. Experiments on Minecraft game-playing, web searching and tool-using tasks show that BCMAAC improves task performance and collaborative behavior compared to naive actor-critic baselines. The improvements are particularly pronounced in multi-turn tasks with richer contextual information, where belief modeling provides a clear advantage.
items.comment: Accepted at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop PTA: From Pretrained Representations to Acting Agents. 18 pages, 3 figures

rm.usage: 面向LLM协作的方法与RM的多机协同（仅能接收雷达数据的哨兵、有限通信下的队友状态推断）在问题形式上相似，可借鉴其“维护信念并据此训练”的思路做通信受限下的队友意图推断；但载体是LLM，落地需大改。

items.title_en: PosePlaner: Denoising Any Feed-Forward Pose Predictor from Pairwise Planar Geometry
items.title_zh: PosePlaner：基于成对平面几何对任意前馈位姿预测器进行去噪
items.abstract_en: Recent multi-view Transformers (e.g., DUSt3R and VGGT) have advanced 3D reconstruction by scaling training data and model capacity from two views to many views and long sequences, subsuming the classical SfM/SLAM pipeline of feature extraction, matching, and pose estimation in a single feed-forward pass. Yet this subsumption hides the interfaces between pipeline stages---correspondences, geometry, and pose are entangled in a single forward pass, leaving supervised fine-tuning as the major path to improvement and offering no mechanism to correct predictions from geometric evidence at test time. We propose PosePlaner to close this gap by reviving the classical coupling between correspondences and pose via flow matching, treating pose refinement as a conditional generation problem that takes coarse geometric matches and initial pose as input condition and fuses the resulting pose hypotheses into a single refined estimate, providing a continuous, data-driven analog of RANSAC voting. Our method is trained efficiently on two-view data, yet serves as a periodic refiner for streaming n-view pose estimators with no retraining. Empirically, it corrects failures of feed-forward predictors, substantially improves correspondence-based solvers, and reduces accumulated drift in long streaming sequences.
items.comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026. Project page: https://robbyant-research.github.io/PosePlaner/

rm.usage: 可用于工程机器人对能量单元、科技核心等弱纹理部件的位姿估计：用多视图前馈位姿预测加平面几何去噪，替代传统PnP在反光/弱纹理下的抖动；也可用于赛前从多张照片重建部件模型。

items.title_en: UniQuery: Unifying Vision Models with a Joint Query Head for Cross-Domain Pedestrian Attribute Recognition
items.title_zh: UniQuery：以联合查询头统一视觉模型实现跨域行人属性识别
items.abstract_en: Pedestrian Attribute Recognition (PAR) predicts semantic attributes of individuals, such as gender, age, clothing and accessories, and its descriptions support attribute-based person retrieval and person re-identification. However, accurately recognizing fine-grained attributes across domains remains challenging due to occlusion, appearance variations, and shifts in image distributions. Ensembles of independently trained foundation encoders combine their logits with fixed fusion weights, so every attribute uses the same mix and the encoders are never trained together. We propose UniQuery, which instead jointly fine-tunes DINOv3 and CLIP for attribute-specific fusion. It combines two query heads, one for each encoder, with a joint query head whose attribute queries attend to tokens from both encoders, and the prediction is the average of the logits of the three query heads. We evaluate UniQuery on the benchmark of the UPAR Challenge 2027 at the WACV 2027 Real-World Surveillance workshop, where models are trained on PA100k, PETA and Market-1501 with a shared set of attributes. In leave-one-dataset-out experiments, UniQuery outperforms the independent ensemble in Challenge_Avg on both held-out datasets. Ablations show that learning fusion over independently trained encoders does not improve upon logit averaging in the mean over the two held-out datasets, while freezing the encoders lowers the Challenge_Avg of UniQuery. On the hidden test set of the benchmark, UniQuery achieves a Challenge_Avg of 0.8001.
items.comment: 10 pages, 6 figures, 5 tables. Submitted to the 7th Real-World Surveillance Workshop (RWS) at WACV 2027

rm.usage: 行人属性识别与自瞄/雷达所需的装甲板数字与灯条识别任务差异明显（RM是近距离特定图标而非跨域行人属性），最多在跨域外观变化的鲁棒性训练策略上有一点参考，实用价值很弱。

items.title_en: RoboJev: An Open Vision-Language Judge for Robot Success Detection
items.title_zh: RoboJev：用于机器人成功检测的开放视觉-语言评判器
items.abstract_en: Many robot manipulation videos do not indicate whether the task was successfully completed. RoboJev-27B is an open-weight vision-language model that takes a task instruction, 10 frames of a manipulation attempt, and (if available) final frames from auxiliary cameras and predicts whether the robot accomplished the task. RoboJev-27B is a variant of JEV-27B-VL, trained with a rank-32 LoRA adapter on the language model only (keeping the vision encoder frozen) using 52,598 episode records. It also uses a source-specific KL penalty that applies only to research data, anchoring predictions closer to the original model on those sources. It uses a calibrated two-token readout that outputs success/failure probabilities in a single forward pass. On 268 held-out episodes of the same robot model (SO-101), RoboJev-27B attains 95.2% balanced accuracy and 0.993 AUROC. It also generalises to episodes collected by unseen labs/robots (AUROC = 0.890 over 459 episodes) as well as to clearly labelled community-collected episodes (accuracy = 93.3% over 135 episodes), where the base model attains an AUROC = 0.900 on the unseen-lab/robot subset with the same inputs. It takes 0.26 seconds per episode (median, serial) to infer on a single H100, which is about \$0.19 per 1,000 success predictions at \$2.69 per GPU-hour (not including media processing and serving costs). RoboJev-27B is released together with its inference code, along with a transparent evaluation: 20,628 predictions organized into 29 model/protocol entries are made available to facilitate browsing and to enable reproducible benchmarking of success detection. We also compare against strong API-based frontier VLMs, which take in fewer input frames (4 images from the primary camera only); note that this comparison is not strictly like-for-like because RoboJev-27B is given more frames at inference.
items.comment: 15 pages, 5 figures

rm.usage: 可作为自动「成功判定器」：给工程机器人装配/取弹的回放或仿真画面加任务指令，自动判断动作是否完成，用于批量打标数据、以及在仿真回归测试中自动统计任务成功率，减少人工看视频。需注意其对 RM 场景与相机视角的泛化要重新验证。

items.title_en: Models Verify Sufficiency, Not Validity: Usable Falsehoods Evade the Checks that Gaps Trigger
items.title_zh: 模型检验的是充分性而非有效性：可利用的虚假信息可规避由空缺触发的检查
items.abstract_en: Ask a model "how many settlements did the Normans control?" and it answers that the passage does not say. Tell it "given that the Normans controlled 12 settlements of 400 inhabitants, what is the total?" and it computes 4,800. Nothing was added to the passage; the unsupported fact merely became usable. Benchmarks for unanswerable questions are built almost entirely by omission, deleting the fact a question needs and scoring refusal, so they never probe this. Holding source support fixed and varying only whether an unsupported premise is usable, flagging drops 8-30 points and commitment to an answer rises 1.5-2.3x on GSM8K across four models spanning two families and 2B-26B; all 16 paired contrasts remain significant after Holm correction. Two further manipulations reproduce it, one also on SQuAD: a fact asserted rather than asked about, and a corrupted intermediate value rather than a removed one. Models articulate the exact gap they then ignore, stating that "there is no financial information provided" for an inert premise and silently adopting a fabricated price for the same item. We read these as one behaviour: whether a model checks depends substantially on whether usable material is present, even when source support is held fixed. Because the main design never instructs models to reject premises introduced in the question, adopting such a premise can also be read as conditional reasoning, and we delimit what the design does and does not show. In the judging seat the pattern differs: asked whether the answer follows, judges pass solutions with a required step deleted 78-99% of the time at every scale tested. A natural prompt-level mitigation lowers accuracy by 22 points without improving detection.
items.comment: Accepted at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on Self-Evolving Diversity-Driven Search for Robust AI Systems (EvoRobust). 5 pages plus references, 3 tables

rm.usage: 研究的是大模型对「不可回答问题」的检验方式，与 RoboMaster 的自瞄、导航、决策等算法环节基本无关；最多在做裁判系统问答/规则问答助手时有一点评测思路参考。

items.title_en: DriveOSS: Dataset and Benchmark for 3D Anomaly Segmentation and Open-set Semantic Segmentation in Autonomous Driving
items.title_zh: DriveOSS：面向自动驾驶中三维异常分割与开放集语义分割的数据集与基准
items.abstract_en: Recent advances in 3D semantic segmentation have significantly improved scene understanding in autonomous driving. However, existing methods are typically developed under a closed-set assumption and evaluated under standard driving conditions, where all categories are known in advance. In real-world driving, autonomous vehicles inevitably encounter previously unseen objects, making closed-set perception insufficient for safe deployment. To address this challenge, we introduce DriveOSS, which, to the best of our knowledge, is the first real-world multimodal dataset and benchmark specifically designed for 3D anomaly segmentation and open-set semantic segmentation. It contains 12,661 synchronized and annotated frames captured using six surround-view RGB cameras, a 128-beam LiDAR, and a GPS/IMU unit. The dataset comprises 52 real-world driving scenes collected under clear, nighttime, cloudy, rainy, and snowy conditions and is organized into ID (in-distribution) and OOD (out-of-distribution) subsets. The ID scenes contain only known classes and are used for training, whereas the OOD scenes additionally contain unknown objects annotated as the outlier class and are used for validation and testing. Extensive experiments show that unseen objects remain a major challenge for current 3D perception systems. The dataset, benchmark protocols, and code are available at https://github.com/chrisyan/DriveOSS.
items.abstract_zh: 现有三维语义分割方法多在闭集假设与标准驾驶条件下开发与评测，而真实驾驶中不可避免会遇到从未见过的物体，闭集感知难以支撑安全部署。为此，作者提出 DriveOSS，这是首个面向三维异常分割与开放集语义分割的真实世界多模态数据集与基准。该数据集包含 12,661 帧同步且带标注的数据，由 6 路环视 RGB 相机、128 线 LiDAR 与 GPS/IMU 采集，覆盖晴、夜、多云、雨、雪五种天气下的 52 个真实驾驶场景，并划分为两个子集：ID（分布内）子集仅含已知类别，用于训练；OOD（分布外）子集额外包含被标注为离群类的未知物体，用于验证与测试。大量实验表明，未见物体仍是当前三维感知系统面临的主要挑战。
items.highlight_zh: 首个面向自动驾驶三维异常与开放集语义分割的真实多模态基准
items.digest_zh:
研究问题：自动驾驶的感知模型通常假设“所有类别事先已知”，但真实道路上一定会出现没见过的物体（如异形车辆、掉落货物）。这类情况会让闭集模型把未知物误判成已知类别，带来安全隐患。但目前缺少专门评测“识别未知物”能力的真实数据集。

方法与数据：作者构建了 DriveOSS。他们用 6 路环视相机、128 线 LiDAR 和 GPS/IMU 同步采集了 12,661 帧数据，覆盖晴天、夜间、多云、雨雪等不同天气与光照下的 52 个真实驾驶场景。数据被分成两半性质不同的部分：ID 子集只含已知类别，用于训练模型；OOD 子集额外包含未知物体，并统一标注为“离群类”，用于验证和测试。这样就能直接衡量模型能否把未知物从已知类别中区分出来。

结果：作者在数据集上跑了大量现有三维感知方法的实验，结论是：未见物体依然是当前系统的一大短板，现有方法在开放场景下表现明显下降。

为何重要：它把“开放世界感知”从概念讨论变成了可复现的公开基准，提供统一的数据、评测协议与代码，让研究者能公平比较不同方法识别未知物体的能力，推动自动驾驶感知从闭集走向开放集，对安全部署有直接意义。
items.comment: Accepted to WACV 2027

rm.usage: 开放集三维语义分割与异常检测基准，思路可用于雷达站激光点云感知：在闭集训练下识别未见过目标/异常点云，提升雷达对敌方机器人及遮挡异常的检出鲁棒性；但数据域是车载驾驶，需自建标注。
rm.task: 雷达目标探测与信息融合

items.title_en: Bracketing Shows the Way: Adaptive Multi-Exposure Policy as Input for Robust Visual SLAM
items.title_zh: 包围曝光指明方向：自适应多曝光策略作为鲁棒视觉SLAM的输入
items.abstract_en: Rapid illumination transitions can disturb Visual SLAM (VSLAM) by saturating images before the Automatic Exposure (AE) policy adapts, removing the visual correspondences needed to maintain tracking. Our proposed methods mitigate this disturbance at two levels: B-Adapt acquires adaptive exposure brackets to cover the scene dynamic range while promoting photometric overlap, and BVSLAM directly uses the multi-exposure sequence as constraints in a factor graph state estimator without relying on High Dynamic Range (HDR) merging. We evaluate both methods against state-of-the-art approaches in nominal environments and during a repeated tunnel-exit transition at an emulated vehicle speed of 32 m s-1. In the tunnel, combining our B-Adapt with BVSLAM reduces the state estimation error by 78 % compared with AE images. These results suggest that bracketing efficiently improves visual pose estimation robustness to rapid illumination disturbances while retaining low error under nominal conditions. Our code is available at https://github.com/norlab-ulaval/bracketing-shows-the-way.
items.comment: 9 pages, 6 figures, submitted to 2027 IEEE International Conference on Robotics and Automation (ICRA 2027)

rm.usage: B-Adapt 的自适应包围曝光与 BVSLAM 直接使用多曝光序列做状态估计，可用于哨兵在场地灯光骤变、逆光、闪光条件下的视觉定位跟踪；自瞄端也可借鉴多曝光采集策略，缓解装甲板过曝丢失。
rm.task: 哨兵机器人自主导航与决策

items.title_en: VERA-Hand: A Verified Multidimensional Benchmark for 2D Hand Pose Estimation in Third-Person Dynamic Gesture Videos
items.title_zh: VERA-Hand：面向第三人称动态手势视频二维手部姿态估计的经人工核验多维基准
items.abstract_en: Hand landmarks serve as input for gesture recognition, sign language understanding, and touchless human-computer interaction. Yet hand pose estimators are typically evaluated with frame-wise localization metrics such as PCK or MPJPE, which are computed over matched predictions and overlook missed or spurious hands, handedness errors, and temporal instability. To address these limitations, we present VERA-Hand, a benchmark that evaluates estimators using manually verified, frame-level 2D annotations for 10,690 hands across four complementary dimensions (detection, localization, identification, and temporal stability), as well as a joint Pose-F1 metric that requires both correct detection and accurate localization. Evaluating six estimators spanning hand-specific, whole-body, reconstruction-based, and foundation-model paradigms, we find that no estimator dominates: rankings reorder sharply across dimensions. VERA-Hand also exposes failures that localization-only and downstream evaluations may not reveal, including cross-hand overlap in over 85% of frames for a recent foundation model. A post-hoc cleanup case study demonstrates how the benchmark can validate corrective interventions, while stratified analyses show that robustness varies across motion-blur classes and hand regions. We release the verified annotations, protocol, and code at https://gibranbenitez.github.io/VERA_Hand/
items.abstract_zh: 手部关键点是手势识别、手语理解与无接触人机交互的基础输入，但手部姿态估计器通常只用 PCK、MPJPE 等逐帧定位指标评测，且只统计匹配上的预测，忽略漏检、虚检、左右手判定错误与时间抖动。为此，作者提出 VERA-Hand 基准：基于人工核验的逐帧二维标注，对 10,690 只手从检测、定位、识别、时间稳定性四个互补维度进行评测，并提出需同时满足正确检测与准确定位的联合指标 Pose-F1。评测覆盖手部专用、全身、重建式与基础模型四类共六个估计器，发现没有哪个估计器全面占优，各维度排名差异明显。该基准还揭示出仅看定位或下游任务难以发现的失败，例如某近期基础模型在超过 85% 的帧中出现左右手重叠。
items.highlight_zh: 提出四维手部姿态评测基准，揭示定位指标看不到的失败
items.digest_zh:
研究问题：手部关键点检测是手势识别、手语翻译、隔空交互等任务的前置环节。然而现有评测几乎只看“关键点位置准不准”（如 PCK、MPJPE），而且只在成功匹配的预测上计算。这会掩盖三类真实问题：根本没检测到手、把背景误检成手、左右手搞反，以及视频中关键点来回抖动。

方法：作者构建了 VERA-Hand 基准，用人工逐帧核验的二维标注覆盖 10,690 只手，从四个互补维度打分：能否检测到（检测）、位置是否准确（定位）、左右手是否判对（识别）、视频中是否稳定（时间稳定性）。此外还设计了联合指标 Pose-F1，只有“检测对且定位准”才算通过，避免单一指标虚高。评测对象包括手部专用模型、全身姿态模型、基于重建的方法和通用基础模型，共六个估计器。

结果：没有任何一个估计器在所有维度上领先，换个维度排名就会大洗牌；某些模型虽然在定位指标上表现不错，但会出现严重的左右手混淆——某近期基础模型在超过 85% 的帧里两只手区域重叠。分层分析还显示，鲁棒性会随运动模糊程度和手部区域不同而变化。

为何重要：它说明“关键点很准”不等于“手部感知可靠”，为手势与手语等下游应用提供了更贴近实际需求的多维评测标准。作者还通过一个事后修正的案例，证明该基准可以用来检验改进手段是否真的有效，并公开了标注、协议与代码。
items.comment: Accepted to WACV 2027

rm.usage: 第三人称手势/手部关键点估计基准，与装甲板点阵识别、能量机关灯臂检测等任务的目标形态无关，仅其“检测+定位+时间稳定性”联合评价指标可借用来评估自瞄跟踪的时序稳定性。

items.title_en: SCOPE: Scene-graph Construction Optimized by Plan Error-correction for Robot Long-term Planning Datasets
items.title_zh: SCOPE：面向机器人长期规划数据集的计划误差校正优化场景图构建
items.abstract_en: Task and Motion Planning (TAMP) stands as a fundamental challenge in robotics, essential for enabling autonomous agents to execute complex, long-horizon tasks in diverse environments. While Large Language Models (LLMs) introduce a new paradigm for TAMP by leveraging extensive common sense, their inherent reasoning limitations hinder direct application, and fine-tuning strategies to enhance these capabilities are currently bottlenecked by the scarcity of high-quality datasets. Existing automated generation methods often suffer from homogeneity, limiting model generalization, and unsolvability, where hallucinated scene graphs create physical mismatches with task goals. To address these issues, we propose Scene-graph Construction Optimized by Plan Error-correction (SCOPE), an automated framework designed to generate diverse and executable TAMP datasets. SCOPE incorporates multi-level diversity metrics to maximize the information entropy of scenarios. Crucially, it introduces a Plan Feedback Error-correction pipeline that utilizes planner execution failures as feedback signals to retroactively rectify logical inconsistencies in scene graphs, ensuring physical feasibility. Experimental results demonstrate that SCOPE exhibits greater robustness to erroneous scene graphs and generates higher-quality data. When utilized for LLM fine-tuning, SCOPE-generated data yield a downstream TAMP model that achieves an absolute 12.33% gain in success rate over its counterpart fine-tuned with data generated by DELTA, a state-of-the-art PDDL-based planner.
items.comment: 8 pages. Accepted at IROS 2026. Project page: https://scope-page.github.io/

rm.usage: 面向 TAMP 的场景图与计划误差校正数据生成，可类比用于工程机器人装配任务的长期任务规划数据构造，但场景与动作空间差异大，对 RM 核心环节帮助有限。

items.title_en: RoboJudge: Multimodal Language Models as Judges for Embodied Video Generation
items.title_zh: RoboJudge：多模态语言模型作为具身视频生成的评判者
items.abstract_en: Video generation models are promising foundations for embodied world models, but only if their generated rollouts are physically valid and faithful to task instructions. Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) are increasingly used to judge these properties, yet their agreement with human judgments on embodied videos has not been systematically evaluated. To address this gap, we introduce RoboJudge-Bench, a benchmark for evaluating MLLMs as judges of embodied video generation. The benchmark measures two fundamental dimensions, Physical Adherence and Instruction Alignment, across 800 human-annotated videos from 8 source corpora and 10 video generators, spanning grippers, human hands, and dexterous hands. Experiments reveal uneven alignment between existing judges and human ratings: general-purpose MLLMs show lower agreement on physical adherence, while specialized video judges designed for general-domain physical reasoning do not consistently transfer to embodied scenarios. Motivated by these findings, we construct RoboJudge-Train, comprising 12K videos annotated with 25K human-verified scores and model-assisted rationales for Physical Adherence and Instruction Alignment. We fine-tune a 9B MLLM on this dataset with supervised learning followed by reinforcement learning, yielding RoboJudge-9B. Among the model judges evaluated on RoboJudge-Bench, RoboJudge-9B achieves the highest overall agreement, reaching a Pearson correlation of 0.719 with a statistically significant 0.089 gain over Gemini-3.7-Flash, the best-performing proprietary baseline in our evaluation. Training on RoboJudge-Train also yields gains on external benchmarks, including VideoPhy2 and Physion-Eval. We further use RoboJudge-9B as a downstream evaluator to benchmark video generation models according to Physical Adherence and Instruction Alignment.
items.comment: Project page: https://spherelab.ai/RoboJudge

rm.usage: 用多模态大模型评判具身视频生成的物理合理性与指令一致性，可作为 RM 仿真/世界模型生成对抗轨迹时的自动评测工具，辅助自瞄、导航策略的仿真验证，属支撑性工具。

items.title_en: Learning Force-Reactive Humanoid Loco-Manipulation
items.title_zh: 学习力反应式人形机器人移动-操作
items.abstract_en: Many everyday tasks require controlling contact force as well as motion. On a humanoid, this force must often be coordinated across both hands and the whole body, and cannot be specified by kinematic trajectories alone. Therefore, we present FLORE, a framework for learning force-reactive humanoid loco-manipulation. We collect robot-free demonstrations using two force-sensing UMI-style handheld grippers for hand motion and contact wrenches, and wearable trackers for body motion. A force-reactive diffusion policy takes vision, proprioception, and measured wrenches as input, then predicts actions and per-hand force commands. A hybrid compliance whole-body controller with force tracking executes these commands while maintaining balance: an integral of the force error measured by real force/torque (F/T) sensors lets each hand track force accurately along the commanded direction and remain compliant along the others. In simulation, the controller tracks per-hand force commands of varied magnitude and direction, with little loss in whole-body motion accuracy. Across three contact-rich tasks on the robot, the force-reactive policy succeeds in 80% of rollouts, compared with 26.7% for a position-only policy trained on the same demonstrations and executed by the same controller. For more details, please visit our website: https://louis-leee.github.io/FLoRe/.
items.comment: 9 pages, 6 figures

rm.usage: 力反应式人形移动操作框架，与 RoboMaster 轮式底盘+云台/机械臂的形态差异大，仅工程机器人装配时的力控思路可作远期参考，直接可用性很低。

items.title_en: Differentiable Contact Dynamics for Legged Locomotion: Policy Learning and Contact-Implicit Trajectory Optimization
items.title_zh: 面向腿足运动的可微接触动力学：策略学习与接触隐式轨迹优化
items.abstract_en: This paper proposes a smooth analytic gradient for frictional contact and applies it to policy learning and contact-implicit trajectory optimization for legged locomotion. The exact contact sensitivity is available in closed form but describes changes within the current contact mode, providing no first-order information toward neighboring contact modes. The proposed gradient replaces this sensitivity only in the backward pass, leaving the hard-contact forward solve unchanged and the realized rollout feasible. A central-path relaxation of the de Saxcé-corrected second-order-cone complementarity problem for Coulomb friction smooths the conditions defining the separating, clamping, and sliding modes. The relaxed sensitivity is evaluated at a point on the central path obtained by a Newton iteration initialized from the hard-contact solution. The sensitivity remains continuous through contact-mode transitions and converges to the exact sensitivity as the relaxation vanishes. Using 100,000 samples and less than 2 min of training on a desktop PC, policy learning with the proposed gradient produces a policy that transfers to hardware without fine-tuning. On hardware, the robot under a trotting policy withstands pushes and traverses debris and slippery ground. In trajectory optimization, the proposed gradient reaches contact-rich solutions missed by exact and Signorini-relaxed gradients. Project page: https://diffcontact.github.io
items.comment: Submitted to Transactions on Robotics

rm.usage: 可微接触动力学与接触隐式轨迹优化面向腿足机器人与摩擦接触，RM 底盘基本不涉及这类接触动力学；若做仿真器物理精度提升可略作参考，但关联弱。

items.title_en: Nonprehensile Robotic Catching Using Virtual Constraints
items.title_zh: 基于虚拟约束的非抓取式机器人接取
items.abstract_en: The problem of nonprehensile robotic catching is addressed using virtual nonholonomic constraints (VNHCs); the motion of the robot end-effector is designed and controlled directly in terms of the states of the object before it is caught on the surface of the end-effector. In contrast to contemporary approaches, our approach avoids the need for object trajectory prediction, and consequent time-varying robot trajectory generation. With a focus on the planar case, we demonstrate that our VNHC approach can be used to catch an object on an end-effector at a desired height, with minimal relative normal velocity at the contact instant. Moreover, the VNHC function depends only on the desired catching height, and the same VNHC can be used for a range of initial conditions. We use model predictive control (MPC) to bring the object and end-effector to rest at a desired location after contact is made. The approach is validated in simulation.
items.comment: 9 pages, 6 figures; an abridged version of this article has been submitted to the 2027 American Control Conference (ACC)

rm.usage: 基于虚拟约束的非抓取式接取，可用于设想中的飞镖/物体拦截末端控制，但 RM 飞镖是发射后弹道飞行、不涉及末端接取，实际关联很弱。

items.title_en: Profiling a Frontier Agent with EBench: From Direct Control to Harness with Policy
items.title_zh: 使用 EBench 对前沿智能体进行性能剖析：从直接控制到带策略的测试框架
items.abstract_en: Frontier multimodal large language models (MLLMs) can control robots without robot-specific training, but how their capabilities compare and interact with post-trained vision-language-action (VLA) and world action model (WAM) policies across manipulation demands remains to be thoroughly evaluated. In this report, we evaluate GPT-6-Astra on EBench as the core of an agent that controls a robot through an agent harness under the same visual and proprioceptive observation protocol as post-trained policies. We study two agent configurations: direct control, in which the agent generates waypoint commands directly, and harness with policy, in which it can also invoke a post-trained VLA or WAM policy for action execution. Under direct control, the agent achieves competitive overall performance relative to post-trained policies. It leads on short-horizon tasks and exhibits the least performance variation across generalization dimensions, whereas it underperforms post-trained policies on long-horizon tasks, tabletop manipulation, and high-precision contact-rich tasks. In the harness with policy, invoking a post-trained VLA or WAM combines the complementary strengths of both components, raising overall task success to the level of the strongest compared post-trained policies while substantially reducing token cost. However, performance remains below the per-task upper bound of the standalone components due to suboptimal policy invocation, fixed-instruction execution without subgoals, and grasp disruption when the agent resumes control. Overall, our study characterizes the capability boundary of a frontier MLLM agent and suggests directions for improving future agent harness design. Project page: https://internrobotics.github.io/EBench-Astra-Tech-Report/
items.comment: Project page: https://internrobotics.github.io/EBench-Astra-Tech-Report/

rm.usage: 多模态大模型控制机器人的评测框架，可借鉴其思路搭建「大模型下达战术指令/航点」的评测环境，评估决策层的可靠性；对具体自瞄/导航算法无直接帮助。

items.title_en: Pretraining Knows What, Simulation Teaches How: Compositional Generalization in a Sim-Trained Robot Agent
items.title_zh: 预训练知道“是什么”，仿真教会“怎么做”：仿真训练机器人智能体中的组合泛化
items.abstract_en: A robot policy needs to understand what a task is asking for in a scene, and how to move the robot to accomplish that task. To achieve these two skills, we introduce Zero-real Agent Policy (ZAP), a recipe that teaches a small off-the-shelf vision-language model to control a robot via a simple tool harness. We use a pretrained 27B parameter model to bootstrap world understanding and reasoning, followed by supervised fine-tuning and GRPO on simple simulated tasks to teach it how to move the robot. Without any real-world robot data during training, ZAP reaches 96.7% success on real-world tasks, matching GPT-6 Astra in our harness and outperforming the MolmoAct2 VLA (33.3%), while running 3x faster and 17x cheaper than GPT-6 Astra. We demonstrate that ZAP also generalizes to completely new objects, goals, strategies, and language by seating a test tube in a rack (and choosing a different hole in the rack when prompted), handing a test tube between arms mid-air, drawing an X on a tic-tac-toe board, and playing chess. These goals and types of manipulation don't appear in our training data. Furthermore, ZAP also transfers to an unseen embodiment. On a single-arm Franka, ZAP reaches 55.9% on RoboLab-120, 4.9 percentage points ahead of the leading VLA/WAM baseline.

rm.usage: 仿真中训练 VLM 智能体做组合泛化的思路，与 sim 任务中「仿真训练+策略泛化」有方法学呼应，可参考其用仿真数据教策略执行的方式，但任务域是机械臂抓取而非 RM。

items.title_en: FOCUS: Active Critic Learning for Long-Horizon Language Model Agents
items.title_zh: FOCUS：面向长时程语言模型智能体的主动评论家学习
items.abstract_en: Sparse outcome rewards make it difficult for long-horizon language-model agents to assign credit to earlier actions. Learned critics provide value estimates for intermediate states, but these estimates can be inaccurate, while estimating intermediate values with repetitive continuation samples from points within a trajectory incurs substantial costs. To mitigate these issues, we introduce FOCUS, an RL method that uses selective branching to help the critic network learn its value estimator. The rollout controller facilitates active learning for the critic by sampling continuations from states that are expected to most reduce the critic's estimation error. These refined value estimates then score the segment between consecutive states with a TD($λ$) advantage, while the sampled evidence supplies training targets for the critic. FOCUS supports long-horizon agentic reinforcement learning through a modular context-management interface that decouples context management from rollout allocation. Our experiments show that using compaction-induced segment boundaries for value estimation and credit assignment, FOCUS outperforms GRPO and VinePPO with matched per-step generation budgets on legal reasoning, deep search, and code localization benchmarks, improving held-out accuracy at Qwen3.5-9B scale by 7.2 points over the strongest baseline on BrowseComp-Plus (55.4 vs. 48.2) and by 4.1 points on DeonticBench (56.5 vs. 52.4).
items.comment: 32 pages, 5 figures

rm.usage: 长时程智能体的主动评论家/信用分配强化学习，可为哨兵/多机全局决策的长时程奖励稀疏问题提供训练技巧参考，属于支撑性思路而非直接方案。

items.title_en: Preference-Guided Cooperation in Multi-Objective Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning
items.title_zh: 多目标多智能体强化学习中的偏好引导合作
items.abstract_en: Multi-objective multi-agent reinforcement learning (MOMARL) addresses agent coordination and objective trade-offs simultaneously while optimising overall system performance. Existing work tends to treat multi-agent cooperation and multi-objective optimisation as largely independent components of a learning problem, which amounts to an exorbitant complexity except in trivial cases. We study here whether the structure provided by multiple objectives can itself be exploited to facilitate cooperation, rather than being treated as an additional optimisation challenge. We formulate MOMARL at both the team and individual levels and introduce objective-wise counterfactual credit assignment to evaluate each agent's contribution across the team objectives. We propose Meta-Gradient Informed Multi-Objective Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning (MIRL), with static (MIRL-S) and dynamic (MIRL-D) variants. By incorporating meta-gradient information, MIRL enables agents to learn how to prioritise objectives individually while collectively optimising the system-level objective, allowing the multi-objective structure to directly guide cooperation. Experiments on a multi-objective multiple particle environment show that our methods improve Pareto-front quality over baselines, with the dynamic variant achieving the strongest performance.
items.comment: 14 pages, 4 figures, 1 table (plus 3 figures, 3 tables, and 2 algorithms in the appendix)

rm.usage: 多目标多智能体强化学习框架可映射到 RM 的多机战术决策：把「控制度争夺/弹丸兑换/增益激活」等作为不同目标，用偏好引导让多机分工协同；但需自行搭建战场抽象环境，落地成本高。

items.title_en: MiRL: Error-Targeted Reinforcement Learning for Correcting Terminal Agent Misbehaviors
items.title_zh: MiRL：用于纠正终端智能体错误行为的错误定向强化学习
items.abstract_en: Error-targeted learning gives a legible way to improve a model: identify specific weaknesses of the model, train the model to fix these weaknesses, and check whether the weaknesses are fixed. We study how to apply error-targeted learning to terminal agents, which solve long-horizon tasks specified in natural language by interacting with a command shell. Existing error-targeted methods are designed for single-turn tasks, and existing analyses of agent failures are used to evaluate and debug agents rather than to train them. We propose Misbehavior-driven RL (MiRL), which first profiles the errors of a policy to find generalizable misbehaviors: kinds of wrong steps that recur across many environments. MiRL then trains the policy with RL, starting rollouts at the steps where these misbehaviors occur and rewarding a rollout only if it passes the tests and avoids the misbehavior. On Qwen3.5-4B, eight misbehaviors account for 52.1% of wrong steps. After training with MiRL, the policy repeats the measured misbehaviors 43% to 57% less often on average on unseen prefixes. MiRL outperforms TMax-4B on Terminal-Bench Lite (51.8% vs. 47.4%) and matches it on Terminal-Bench 2.1 (21.3% vs. 20.6%), while using 35% of its rollouts. These results show that error-targeted learning can be applied to realistic, long-horizon terminal tasks.
items.comment: 20 pages, 14 figures, 5 tables. Project page: https://github.com/runchu-tian/MiRL

rm.usage: 面向命令行终端智能体的错误定向强化学习，与自瞄、导航、决策等具身任务差异很大，最多在调试机器人上层任务脚本时借鉴其「先定位失败模式再训练」的思路，关联很弱。

items.title_en: TrySee: Modular Perception-Enhanced VLM Grounding for Closed-Loop Robot Task Planning in Specialized Domains
items.title_zh: TrySee：面向专用领域闭环机器人任务规划的模块化感知增强 VLM 接地
items.abstract_en: Vision Language Models (VLMs) have shown impressive capabilities in high-level reasoning and task planning for robots. However, specialized domains remain a challenge for VLMs' image interpretation and grounding abilities. We introduce TrySee, a modular closed-loop robot task planning pipeline integrating general-purpose VLM reasoning with domain-specific perception and established robotics components. The system consists of an inherently reactive cyclic planning pipeline, augmented with domain-specific modular vision preprocessing, to provide online grounding. Finally, a dynamic preprocessing selection mechanism contributes to the scalability of the pipeline. The system requires neither VLM fine-tuning nor end-to-end demonstrations and adapts through replaceable perception modules and motion planning. The approach is evaluated on planning tasks across 5 widely different domains, including a real-world robot disassembly task. The field tests in a brownfield environment demonstrate the approach's practicality in integrating VLM planning into specialized robotic systems with limited domain-specific training data.
items.comment: To be published in the proceedings of the 2026 IEEE International Conference on Robotics and Biomimetics (ROBIO)

items.title_en: Continuous-Time Safe Planning and Control for Agile Quadrupeds
items.title_zh: 敏捷四足机器人的连续时间安全规划与控制
items.abstract_en: Agile quadruped navigation in dynamic environments demands trajectories that are both dynamically feasible and provably collision-free. Most real-time planners achieve tractability through a convex reduction that requires simplified kinematic models, discarding motion that the robot can readily execute, and certify safety only at discretization points, leaving open possible inter-sample collisions with moving obstacles. We present a real-time motion planning framework that retains the fully-actuated $SE(2)$ model of a quadruped, with its anisotropic, heading-coupled velocity bounds, and accepts the resulting nonconvexity. By parameterizing trajectories as composite Bernstein polynomials, we exploit the convex hull property to certify collision avoidance and the input bounds over the entirety of each planning horizon. Solved at online replanning rates, the optimization runs in closed loop, commanding body velocities to the locomotion controller. We validate the approach in simulation against ablations and external baselines, and in hardware experiments on a quadruped navigating among unknown moving obstacles, recovering both lateral and heading-coupled motion that simplified models exclude.

items.title_en: Provably Efficient Q-learning for Robust Reinforcement Learning
items.title_zh: 面向鲁棒强化学习的可证明高效 Q-learning
items.abstract_en: Standard reinforcement learning (RL) algorithms based on Markov Decision Processes (MDPs) are vulnerable to sim-to-real gaps. To address this issue, distributionally robust RL algorithms based on robust MDPs (RMDPs) have been proposed, for ensuring that agents can perform reliably to unpredictable conditions in real-world environments. Despite of the rich literature, \revision{an efficient model-free method is still lacking} for robust RL, particularly for Markovian data, which is more relevant in practical applications. In this work, we take a step towards settling this problem by proposing a sample efficient (asynchronous Q-learning) algorithm for robust RL. In particular, consider a $γ$-discounted infinite-horizon RMDP with state space $\mathcal{S}$ and action space $\mathcal{A}$, where the uncertainty set is specified by the total variation (TV) distance with uncertainty level $σ$. Assuming access to a single trajectory of Markovian samples induced by a behavior policy and the nominal transition kernel, the sample complexity of the proposed Q-learning algorithm --- to achieve an entrywise $\varepsilon$-approximation of the optimal Q-function --- is bounded by $$ \frac{1}{μ_{\mathsf{min}}\varepsilon^2(1-γ)^3\max\{1-γ,σ\}} + \frac{t_{\mathsf{mix}}}{μ_{\mathsf{min}}(1-γ)} $$ up to logarithmic factors. Here, $t_{\mathsf{mix}}$ and $μ_{\mathsf{min}}$ denote the mixing time and the minimum state-action occupancy probability of the sample trajectory, respectively. This result is nearly minimax optimal, with an additional factor of $\frac{1}{1-γ}$. Moreover, it achieves a significant improvement over existing bounds.

items.title_en: VPR-Space: A Benchmark for Visual Place Recognition in Space Analog Domains
items.title_zh: VPR-Space：太空模拟域中视觉位置识别的基准
items.abstract_en: Visual Place Recognition (VPR) is an important means for loop closure detection in visual Simultaneous Localization and Mapping (SLAM). While state-of-the-art VPR and SLAM approaches excel in urban and feature-rich natural environments, the vast and feature-poor environments of extraterrestrial surfaces like on the Moon or Mars pose severe challenges for existing approaches. This paper presents a novel benchmark, VPR-Space, to evaluate VPR capabilities on extraterrestrial surfaces. There are three contributions: (1) We collected sixteen VPR database-query datasets based on existing data from Space Analog Domains (SAD), terrestrial environments that resemble properties of the Moon or Mars. The collection includes a range of challenges regarding environment, viewpoint change, and illumination conditions. (2) To address the ill-posed nature of VPR, we propose a novel approach to generate the ground-truth information in VPR benchmarks. Instead of defining that a query and datbase image show the same place if and only if their camera poses are within fixed position and viewing direction thresholds, we propose to make the decision dependent on whether the match would be valuable in the downstream SLAM task. To avoid the overhead and restrictions of evaluating VPR in-the-loop within SLAM systems, we provide VPR ground-truth (GT) matrices based on the performance of an ensemble of state-of-the-art Relative Pose Estimators (RPE). Under this GT we require a VPR method to identify exactly those image pairs for which a subsequently applied RPE is expected to provide a valuable pose estimate in a SLAM context. (3) We evaluated nine state-of-the-art VPR approaches. The results show considerable room for improvement and indicate directions for future research. We provide a pre-release version of the dataset on github: $\texttt{https://github.com/rfechner/VPR-Space}$

items.title_en: Adapt for Planning, Not just Prediction: Optimistic Test-Time World Model Adaptation
items.title_zh: 为规划而适应，而不仅是预测：乐观的测试时世界模型适应
items.abstract_en: Latent world models are typically pre-trained offline and kept frozen at test time, so planning with them can degrade under distribution shift. Test-time adaptation (TTA) can mitigate this degradation by updating the model during deployment. Unlike pre-training on fixed data, TTA for planning is closed-loop: the planner uses model rollouts to select actions, and the resulting transitions drive the next update. This raises the question: which objective should guide TTA for planning? Under a prediction-only objective, the model is fit only to the outcomes of its own actions, so it can remain wrong about the actions that would reach the goal, and low prediction error need not translate into better planning. Inspired by reward-biased maximum likelihood from adaptive control, we introduce Optimistic Test-Time Adaptation (OpTTA). Its objective has two terms, the prediction loss on observed transitions and the planner's goal-reaching cost on its candidate rollouts, both minimized over the model parameters. The planning term biases adaptation toward models that are optimistic about reaching the goal, without any additional environment interaction. Across visual and environment shifts on manipulation, reaching and navigation tasks, OpTTA raises final planning success over the frozen model by 13.5 percentage points on average, compared with 6.9 for the prediction-only objective (AdaJEPA), when only the predictor is adapted. When the encoder is adapted as well, the gains are 13.5 and 7.5 points. These experiments span three JEPA world models with different encoders and training objectives and, for temporal straightening, both CEM and gradient-based planners. Our results suggest that test-time adaptation of world models for planning benefits from an optimistic, task-aware term in addition to the prediction loss.
items.comment: Accepted at the CoRL 2026 Workshop on Pretrain to Adapt

items.title_en: Distributed Predictive Flocking for a Swarm of Miniature Vibration-Driven Robots in a Confined Arena
items.title_zh: 受限场地中微型振动驱动机器人集群的分布式预测群集
items.abstract_en: Coordinating many miniature robots in a confined arena, with no leader, central planner, or global map, is a core challenge for swarm robotics. As the swarm grows denser, collision avoidance becomes the limiting factor, and the number of safely coexisting robots depends on the formulation of the inter-robot safety constraint. We present a distributed predictive flocking controller in which each robot solves its own nonlinear model predictive control (NMPC) problem, optimizing swarm cohesion and alignment costs, inter-robot and obstacle safety, and a task objective, while exchanging only predicted trajectories with local neighbors. Within this generalized controller architecture, solved in real time, we compare six barrier and control-barrier-function (CBF) safety formulations on a digital twin of an open-source vibration-driven bristlebot in a $0.64\,\mathrm{m^2}$ arena. A look-ahead discrete-time CBF performs best overall, with the fewest collisions and the widest inter-robot margins across nearly every swarm size tested. We deploy it on phototaxis, phototactic orbiting, and cohesion without a stimulus tasks, using swarm sizes starting from ten robots and up to the geometric packing limit. The swarm holds well: collisions stay low in small swarms, rising steeply as the packing limit approaches, while coordination and cohesion degrade gently rather than collapsing. The swarm is found not to trade safety for order, keeping both across the confined arena, with local alignment high at every swarm size.

items.title_en: Copying As Defense: Protecting Images from Editing By Eliciting Model Copying
items.title_zh: 复制作为防御：通过诱导模型复制来保护图像免遭编辑
items.abstract_en: Image editors built on diffusion transformers (DiTs), such as Flux Kontext, make it possible to turn a single photograph into a convincing manipulated image, including harmful and non-consensual edits. Proactive defenses aim to prevent such manipulations by adding an imperceptible perturbation before an image is shared. Existing defenses for DiT-based in-context editors make the output attend less to the protected reference image. But this leaves the model free to follow the edit instruction using the text and its own generated tokens, often producing a new, weakly grounded image rather than preventing the edit. We find that the opposite strategy is more effective: instead of leading the model to ignore the reference, we encourage it to copy it. Through controlled attention interventions, we show that concentrating target-token attention on the reference image in only a few early blocks is sufficient to collapse the editing behavior, causing the model to reproduce its input, often as a lossy copy, rather than execute the requested transformation. Based on this insight, we introduce Copying-as-Defense (CaD), which maximizes per-token target-to-reference attention mass in early transformer blocks. Since attention rows are normalized, increasing reference attention suppresses the attention allocated to the text and generated canvas. Restricting the objective to early blocks also lets us truncate the backpropagation path, keeping optimization cheap. Across editors and benchmarks, CaD reduces average edit success from 81.4% on unprotected images to 24.0%, a 70.6% relative reduction, and by a further 44.3% relative to DeContext, the strongest baseline (43.0%). CaD is also roughly 1.8-2.0x faster per optimization step than comparable methods.
